verdict.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Existence(has_key) is redundant and should be removed. The task commands only the goal ('Go to the goal'); the key is required only through the 'if you reach the goal, you must also have picked up the key' sentence, which is correctly captured by the hard RespondedExistence(at_goal, has_key). Remove Existence(has_key); keep Existence(at_goal) and RespondedExistence(at_goal, has_key).
